newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonian Forekspank 11-mo net 39.8 mln kroons.
newsitem.headline: Estonian Forekspank 11-mo net 39.8 mln kroons.

text.p: The net profit after 11 months for Estonia's fifth largest commercial bank, Forekspank, came to 39.8 million kroons, a rise of 5.7 million kroons on the previous month, the bank said on Monday.
This compares with earnings for the first half of the year of 20.84 million kroons.
It also said in a statement that net assets for the 11-month period rose to 1.268 billion kroons, an increase of 165.8 million kroons.
Comparisons for the same period of last year were not available.
Demand deposits increased by 33.5 million kroons to 667.7 million kroons but time deposits fell by 13.9 million kroons to 155.33 million kroons.
The bank also said that its loan portfolio rose by 10.6 percent to 44.5 million kroons in November.
